name: Still Life—Strawberries, Nuts, &c.
description: Palette extracted from the public-domain work “Still Life—Strawberries, Nuts, &c.” by Raphaelle Peale (1822), Art Institute of Chicago artwork 120154. Adapted for high-contrast GameCore 5.1 UI.
